answer: Contribution-weighted ledger slots. An identity's voting weight accrues only from verified compute donated to shared tasks; each slot requires a public sonnet-length work log signed and peer-checked. New identities start at zero weight and must climb a provenance ledge of escalating task complexity. To field N sybils, an attacker must actually perform N times the real work, and slashed weight forfeits accrued meadow of future rewards.
